# Lucho Escobedo

> Data and AI executive with 20 years designing and
> scaling enterprise systems that convert data into
> decisions, value, and durable competitive advantage
> — across McKinsey, Fortune 500 corporations, and
> unicorn startups like REEF Technology, spanning four
> continents. Founder and investor across ventures in
> AI consulting, real estate, small business acquisition,
> and B2B commerce infrastructure. Fulbright Scholar.
> PhD in Geospatial Economics, University of Illinois
> at Urbana-Champaign. Based in Lima, Peru.

## About

- [Lucho Escobedo](https://luchoescobedo.com):
  Executive profile, ventures, career history,
  and contact.

## Writing

### Institutional Intelligence
Column on AI, strategy, and organizational
decision-making for executives. Written from Peru,
interpreting global technological shifts through
a Latin American lens. For investors, CEOs, policy
makers, and founders with institutional
responsibility over the region. English only.

- [Institutional Intelligence](https://luchoescobedo.com/institutional-intelligence/):
  Column index and all published essays.
- [Defined Terms](https://luchoescobedo.com/institutional-intelligence/2026/defined-terms/) (2026-10-05):
  As many as 90 percent of enterprises are still deploying tools, while the leaders did the work every budget deferred. A restaurant franchise is a recipe to which everyone has agreed.
- [The Authorship of a Forecast](https://luchoescobedo.com/institutional-intelligence/2026/authorship-of-a-forecast/) (2026-09-17):
  Serious estimates of what AI will do to the global economy span two orders of magnitude, and who produced each number explains more than the number itself.
- [Exclusions Apply](https://luchoescobedo.com/institutional-intelligence/2026/exclusions-apply/) (2026-07-29):
  Microsoft cut the cost of intelligence by up to ninety percent and raised its spending anyway. A price collapse reaches only what can be replaced.
- [The New Commodity](https://luchoescobedo.com/institutional-intelligence/2026/the-new-commodity/) (2026-06-29):
  Latin America holds precisely the reserves the AI buildout requires. The structural position it is being assigned is one it has held before.
- [Peru and Artificial Intelligence: Fifty Years Compressed](https://luchoescobedo.com/institutional-intelligence/2026/fifty-years-compressed/) (2026-06-01):
  When speed becomes a form of discipline, institutions are built while the economy moves. Peru is attempting the compression now.
- [The Strategic Choice](https://luchoescobedo.com/institutional-intelligence/2026/strategic-choice/) (2026-05-10):
  When governance arrives after infrastructure begins to move, the test is whether strategy becomes action.
- [The Window of Opportunity](https://luchoescobedo.com/institutional-intelligence/2026/window-of-opportunity/) (2026-04-01):
  When open-weight AI democratizes access, the region has months to move. The window is closing.
- [Peru's Position](https://luchoescobedo.com/institutional-intelligence/2026/peru-position/) (2026-03-01):
  Peru leads in governance and adoption but lags in innovation capacity. The gap is strategic, not regulatory.
- [Credit, Clarity, and AI](https://luchoescobedo.com/institutional-intelligence/2026/credit-clarity-ai/) (2026-02-01):
  When algorithms decide who gets credit, clarity is not a regulatory choice. It is the foundation for trust and access.
- [The Architecture of Power](https://luchoescobedo.com/institutional-intelligence/2026/architecture-of-power/) (2026-01-01):
  Nvidia's dominance, Intel's acquisition by the U.S. government, and what it means for Latin America's position in the semiconductor value chain.
- [Institutional Intelligence](https://luchoescobedo.com/institutional-intelligence/2025/inaugural/) (2025-12-01):
  The region's binding constraint is not technology but clarity. A column concerned with that deficit.

### The Wolf's Den
Personal essays on discipline, identity,
leadership, and the person behind the work.
English only.

- [The Wolf's Den](https://luchoescobedo.com/blog/):
  Personal writing archive.
- [What Kept Making Room](https://luchoescobedo.com/blog/2026/What-Kept-Making-Room/) (2026-09-01):
  On pruning, neglect, and the difference between a thing that dies and a thing that simply waits.
- [Pain](https://luchoescobedo.com/blog/2026/Pain/) (2026-05-30):
  On injury, the easy path of destruction, and what a man builds in the silence instead.
- [The Shape That Remains](https://luchoescobedo.com/blog/2025/The_Shape_That_Remains/) (2025-10-11):
  On endurance, refinement, and the slow transformations that define us.
- [The Way in All Things](https://luchoescobedo.com/blog/2025/The_Way_Is/) (2025-08-28):
  The quiet discovery that mastery is a transferable way of being.
- [The Flight Home](https://luchoescobedo.com/blog/2025/The-Flight-home/) (2025-08-04):
  Tracing the invisible current between movement and meaning.
- [All Things Change When We Do](https://luchoescobedo.com/blog/2025/On-Change/) (2025-07-18):
  A personal reflection on change, identity, and the quiet power of internal transformation.
- [From Solitude to Strength: On Having A Personal Den](https://luchoescobedo.com/blog/2025/The_Wolfs_Den/) (2025-05-06):
  Reflections on solitude, identity, and the purpose behind The Wolf's Den.
